Regenerated from the canonical template in the website repo. The OEM section
claimed unlimited developer seats with no separate per-developer licence. The
CTO confirmed on 2026-10-30 that OEM grants redistribution rights for one
application and nothing else: each developer who works with the product in it
also needs a Community + Commercial licence, whatever features the product
uses, because the licence key comes from the OEM line and already renders
every licensed feature.

See 10.14 of docs/licence-naming-audit.md in
